name: Asshur
overview: Asshur is a male figure identified in Scripture as the son of Shem, one of the sons of Noah. His mention is brief and specific, focusing primarily on his genealogical position within the post-flood human family. No additional tribal affiliation or notable personal details are provided beyond his lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Asshur appears as a proper name in Genesis 10:22. There is no recorded meaning or divine origin associated with this name in the biblical text, and it is presented simply as a personal name without further explanation.
familyAndRelationships: Asshur is explicitly identified as a son of Shem, establishing his place within the Shemite lineage. Scripture does not record any other family relationships or descendants for Asshur beyond this direct paternal connection.
scriptureSignificance: Asshur's significance in the biblical narrative lies in his role as a progenitor within the line of Shem, which is foundational for understanding the genealogical records following the flood. His mention helps trace the development of nations and peoples as outlined in Genesis 10. Though details about his life are sparse, his inclusion underscores the faithfulness of God's preservation of humanity through Noah's descendants.
